items.title: Rudy Mazzari Interview, 1959-11-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...what did George Washington say when he crossed the Delaware? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, he said, fa no cazzo di freddo.

ctx.x: for supper at a real southern Mississippi family's house and of course his friend had been invited along too, you know, and well they were very hospitable, you know, and all that and we were having dinner and everything was going along fine until, oh, I think we were carrying a conversation about Italy and this lady of course kept shooting questions at me about Italy, she wanted to know what the people did and how they did it and all that and then came the bomb and she says, well, we Christians don't do things…

Yeah, I don't know what to say because the tape's about to run off, why don't we let it run off? Just let it rip. Okay. The first thing I want to know is, see as you're calling up leave, is what did George Washington say when he crossed the Delaware?
Oh, he said, fa no cazzo di freddo. Good. That's out of the way.
